source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 9 (PDF 192-228), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Electrostatics and Current Electricity) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is meant by quantization of charge?
(Charge ki quantization se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C sab se chhota aazad charge hai; bare charges electrons barha ya ghata kar bante hain. Is liye har charge e ka integer guna hai: q = Ne, N integer.

book_ref.quote: It is the minimum amount of charge that any particle may contain.

blocks.prompt:
2 How many electrons must be added to a neutral body to give it a charge of −8 μC? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
(Neutral jism ko −8 μC charge dene ke liye kitne electrons shamil karne honge? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))
blocks.explanation: q = Ne, is liye N = q/e = 8 × 10⁻⁶ / 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ = 5 × 10¹³ electrons.

book_ref.quote: Thus, any amount of charge q is an integer multiple of e, i.e.,

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between electrostatics and electric current.
(Electrostatics aur electric current mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrostatics saakin charges se mutaalliq hai; electric current harkat karte charges hain.

book_ref.quote: When charges are in motion, we call it as an electric current.

rows: Saakin charges ke mazahir aur khususiyaat ka mutala.
Harkat karte charges.
Misaal: do charged jismon ke darmiyan force (Coulomb ka qanoon).
Misaal: taar mein aazad electrons ka bahao, I = Q/t.

blocks.prompt:
4 State Coulomb's law and write it in mathematical form for free space.
(Coulomb ka qanoon bayan karein aur free space ke liye riyazi shakal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Do point charges ke darmiyan force un ki miqdaaron ke hasil-e-zarb ke seedha aur faasle ke murabba ke ulat mutanasib hai: F = (1/4πε₀)(q₁q₂/r²), jahan 1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻². Yeh charges ko milane wali line par amal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: The force between two-point charges is directly proportional to the product of the magnitudes of charges

blocks.prompt:
5 Coulomb's force is called a mutual force. What does this mean?
(Coulomb force ko bahami (mutual) force kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar q₁ q₂ par force lagaye to q₂ bhi q₁ par barabar aur mukhalif force lagata hai: F₁₂ = −F₂₁. Dono ki miqdaar Eq. 9.3 se; charges ke nishan kashish ya dafa batate hain.

book_ref.quote: If we denote the force exerted on q₂ by q₁ as F₂₁

blocks.prompt:
6 What is relative permittivity? How does a dielectric change the Coulomb force?
(Relative permittivity kya hai? Dielectric Coulomb force ko kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dielectric free space ke muqable mein force ko aik mustaqil factor se kam karta hai; yeh factor relative permittivity εᵣ hai. Medium mein F = (1/4πε₀εᵣ)(q₁q₂/r²), yani εᵣ guna kam.

book_ref.quote: This constant is known as relative permittivity and is represented by εᵣ.

blocks.prompt:
7 Two point charges of 5 μC and 4 μC are 0.2 m apart in air. Find the force between them. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)
(Hawa mein 5 μC aur 4 μC ke do point charges 0.2 m door hain. Un ke darmiyan force nikalein. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))

book_ref.quote: Coulomb's law is essential in understanding the behaviour of charged particles

blocks.prompt:
8 Each of two point charges is doubled and the distance between them is halved. How does the force change?
(Do point charges mein se har aik dugna aur un ka faasla aadha kar diya jaye to force kaise badlegi?)
blocks.explanation: F ∝ q₁q₂/r². Nayi F ∝ (2q₁)(2q₂)/(r/2)² = 16 q₁q₂/r², yani force 16 guna ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: where F is the magnitude of the mutual force that acts on each of the two point charges

blocks.prompt:
9 Is electric intensity a scalar or a vector? What is its direction?
(Electric intensity scalar hai ya vector? Is ki simt kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electric intensity E = F/q per unit positive charge force hai, is liye vector hai. Is ki simt us nuqte par rakhe positive charge par force F ki simt hai.

book_ref.quote: The direction of E is the same as that of F.

blocks.prompt:
10 Find the electric intensity at a distance of 1 m from a point charge of 5 μC in air. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)
(Hawa mein 5 μC point charge se 1 m faasle par electric intensity nikalein. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: E = kq/r² = 9 × 10⁹ × 5 × 10⁻⁶ / 1² = 4.5 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹, charge se door ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: The strength of the field at a position is known as its intensity at that point.

blocks.prompt:
11 A charge of 5 nC is placed in an electric field of 4 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹. Find the force on it.
(5 nC charge 4 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ ki electric field mein rakha gaya hai. Us par force nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: F = qE = 5 × 10⁻⁹ × 4 × 10⁴ = 2 × 10⁻⁴ N, E ki simt mein (positive charge).

book_ref.quote: The Eq. 9.5 can also be written as:

blocks.prompt:
12 What are electric field lines? Why are they also called lines of force?
(Electric field lines kya hain? Inhein lines of force kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electric field lines (Michael Faraday ka tasawwur) charged jism ke gird field ki simt aur taqat ka nazri naqsha hain. Yeh charge par electric force ki maloomat deti hain, is liye lines of force bhi kehlati hain.

book_ref.quote: Electric field lines can be considered as a visual map used to represent the direction and strength

blocks.prompt:
13 Write any three properties of electric field lines.
(Electric field lines ki koi teen khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Positive charges se shuru ho kar negative charges par khatam hoti hain. (2) Kisi nuqte par tangent E ki simt deta hai. (3) Taqatwar field mein qareeb aur kamzor mein door hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Electric field lines originate from positive charges and end on negative charges.

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between the field lines of an isolated positive charge and an isolated negative charge.
(Akele positive charge aur akele negative charge ki field lines mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: +q ki lines radial bahar aur −q ki radial andar hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Figure 9.6 shows the electric field lines in the vicinity of a negative charge −q.

rows: Field lines radial bahar ki taraf.
Field lines radial andar ki taraf.
Positive test charge door dhakela jata hai.
Positive test charge kheencha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is a neutral zone in the field of two identical positive charges?
(Do yaksaan positive charges ki field mein neutral zone kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do yaksaan charges ke darmiyan lines aik doosre ko dhakelti aur mur jaati hain. Beech ka woh hissa jahan dono ki fields khatam ho jaati hain zero field spot ya neutral zone hai.

book_ref.quote: It reveals that the lines in the region between two like charges seem to repel each other.

blocks.prompt:
16 How do field lines show a uniform electric field? Give an example.
(Field lines uniform electric field ko kaise zahir karti hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jahan lines mutawazi aur barabar faasle par hon, har unit area se barabar lines guzarti hain, is liye field har jagah yaksaan hai. Misaal: parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka darmiyani hissa.

book_ref.quote: Figure 9.9 shows the field lines between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor.

blocks.prompt:
17 Define electric flux. Give its SI unit.
(Electric flux ki definition aur SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Electric flux φₑ kisi area se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad hai: φₑ = E·A = EA cos θ. Yeh scalar hai; SI unit N m² C⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: It is usually denoted by Greek letter φₑ.

blocks.prompt:
18 When is the electric flux through an area maximum and when is it zero?
(Kisi area se electric flux kab zyada se zyada aur kab sifr hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada se zyada (φₑ = EA) jab area field lines par amoodi ho (E aur vector area mein θ = 0°). Sifr jab area lines ke mutawazi ho (θ = 90°), kyunke koi line nahi guzarti.

book_ref.quote: In this case, we have to find the projection of the area which is perpendicular to the field lines.

blocks.prompt:
19 A flat area of 0.2 m² is placed in a uniform field of 3 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ with its normal at 60° to the field. Find the flux.
(0.2 m² ka hamwaar area 3 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ ki uniform field mein hai aur us ka normal field se 60° par hai. Flux nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: φₑ = EA cos θ = 3 × 10⁴ × 0.2 × 0.5 = 3000 N m² C⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Usually, the element of area is represented by a vector area A

blocks.prompt:
20 Show that the flux through a sphere with a charge q at its centre does not depend on the radius.
(Sabit karein ke markaz par charge q wale sphere se flux radius par munhasir nahi.)
blocks.explanation: Sphere par E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²) har patch ke mutawazi hai, is liye φₑ = E × 4πr² = q/ε₀. r² kat jata hai, is liye flux r se aazad hai.

book_ref.quote: It depends upon the medium and the charge enclosed.

blocks.prompt:
21 State Gauss's law and write its mathematical form.
(Gauss ka qanoon bayan karein aur us ki riyazi shakal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi bhi band satah se kul electric flux us mein band kul charge ka 1/ε₀ guna hai: φₑ = Q/ε₀, jahan Q = q₁ + q₂ + … + qₙ.

book_ref.quote: Equation 9.14 is mathematical expression of Gauss's law which can be stated as:

blocks.prompt:
22 What is a Gaussian surface? How is it chosen?
(Gaussian surface kya hai? Ise kaise chuna jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aik khayali band satah hai jo us nuqte se guzarti hai jahan E nikalna ho. Ise aise chunte hain ke flux aasani se nikle, maslan charged sphere ke liye hum-markaz sphere.

book_ref.quote: Its choice is such that the flux through it can be easily evaluated.

blocks.prompt:
23 A charge of 2 μC is enclosed by a closed surface. Find the total flux through it. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²)
(Aik band satah 2 μC charge ko gherti hai. Us se kul flux nikalein. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²))
blocks.explanation: φₑ = Q/ε₀ = 2 × 10⁻⁶ / 8.85 × 10⁻¹² = 2.26 × 10⁵ N m² C⁻¹, satah ki shakal kuch bhi ho.

book_ref.quote: Since φₑ = q/ε₀, so the electric flux passing through the closed surface is:

blocks.prompt:
24 What is the electric field at a point outside a charged conducting sphere?
(Charged conducting sphere ke bahar kisi nuqte par electric field kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gauss ke qanoon se E × 4πr² = q/ε₀, yani E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²), radial rukh mein. Bahar field aisi hai jaise saara charge markaz par ho.

book_ref.quote: This shows that the field at any point outside the sphere is the same

blocks.prompt:
25 Define potential difference and the volt.
(Potential difference aur volt ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: A aur B ke darmiyan potential difference unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein A se B tak le jane ka kaam hai: ΔV = W_AB/q. Do nuqton mein 1 volt hai agar 1 C positive charge le jane mein 1 J kaam ho: 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: To describe electric field, we introduce the idea of electric potential difference.

blocks.prompt:
26 Why is the electric potential at a point a relative quantity?
(Kisi nuqte par electric potential nisbati (relative) quantity kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Potential aik sifr potential wale hawala nuqte ke lehaaz se hai, jo aam tor par infinity par hota hai. V = W/q infinity se unit positive charge lane ka kaam hai, is liye potential hamesha infinity ke lehaaz se hai.

book_ref.quote: So, the potential at a point is always relative to potential at infinity.

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between electric potential energy difference and electric potential difference.
(Electric potential energy difference aur electric potential difference mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka taaluq ΔU = qΔV hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the potential difference between the two points can be defined as the difference of the potential energy per unit charge.

rows: Charge q ko equilibrium mein A se B le jane ka kaam: ΔU = W_AB.
Per unit positive charge kaam: ΔV = W_AB/q.
Le jaaye gaye charge ki miqdaar par munhasir.
Le jaaye gaye charge par munhasir nahi.
Unit: joule (J).
Unit: volt (V) = J C⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
28 How much work is needed to move a charge of 4 μC through a potential difference of 250 V?
(4 μC charge ko 250 V potential difference se guzarne ke liye kitna kaam chahiye?)

book_ref.quote: Let W_AB be the work done by the force in carrying the positive charge q from A to B

blocks.prompt:
29 What is potential gradient? Why is there a negative sign in E = −ΔV/Δd?
(Potential gradient kya hai? E = −ΔV/Δd mein manfi nishan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Potential gradient ΔV/Δd faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki zyada se zyada sharah hai, field line ke saath. E potential gradient ka manfi hai; manfi nishan batata hai ke E ghatte potential ki taraf hai.

book_ref.quote: It is known as potential gradient.

blocks.prompt:
30 Show that 1 V m⁻¹ = 1 N C⁻¹.
(Sabit karein ke 1 V m⁻¹ = 1 N C⁻¹.)
blocks.explanation: 1 V m⁻¹ = 1 (J C⁻¹)/m = 1 (N × m)/(m × C) = 1 N C⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: The unit of electric intensity from Eq. 9.23 is volt/metre

blocks.prompt:
31 Two parallel plates 5 mm apart have a potential difference of 50 V. Find the electric intensity between them.
(5 mm faasle wali do mutawazi plates ke darmiyan 50 V potential difference hai. Un ke darmiyan electric intensity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: E = ΔV/Δd = 50 / 5 × 10⁻³ = 1 × 10⁴ V m⁻¹ (= N C⁻¹), positive se negative plate ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: If the plates A and B are separated by infinitesimally small distance Δd

blocks.prompt:
32 What does an ECG record?
(ECG kya record karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: ECG insani jild ke nuqton ke darmiyan woh voltage (potential difference) record karta hai jo dil ke electrical amal se paida hota hai. Daurte hue banaya jaye to dabao mein dil ki karkardagi batata hai.

book_ref.quote: An ECG records the “voltage” between points on human skin generated by electrical process in the heart.

blocks.prompt:
33 Define one electron-volt and give its value in joules.
(Aik electron-volt ki definition aur joules mein qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik electron-volt woh energy hai jo electron aik volt potential difference se guzar kar hasil ya zaya karta hai. 1 eV = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(1 V) = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J.

book_ref.quote: is called one electron-volt and is denoted by 1 eV

blocks.prompt:
34 A particle of charge 2e is accelerated through 500 V. Find its gain in kinetic energy in eV and in joules.
(2e charge wala zarra 500 V se accelerate hota hai. Us ki kinetic energy mein izafa eV aur joules mein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If no external force acts on the charge to maintain equilibrium

blocks.text: 9.7 Motion of charged particles in a uniform electric field

blocks.prompt:
35 In which direction do positive and negative charges move in a uniform field between two plates? Why?
(Do plates ke darmiyan uniform field mein positive aur negative charges kis rukh mein chalte hain? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Force F = qE hai. Positive charge E ke rukh mein (positive se negative plate ki taraf) aur negative charge E ke mukhalif, positive plate ki taraf chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: A positive charge +q placed in the field will move in the direction of electric field

blocks.prompt:
36 Find the acceleration of a proton in a uniform field of 1000 N C⁻¹. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, mass of proton = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)
(1000 N C⁻¹ ki uniform field mein proton ka acceleration nikalein. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, proton ka mass = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg))
blocks.explanation: a = qE/m = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 1000 / 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ = 9.6 × 10¹⁰ m s⁻², E ke rukh mein.

book_ref.quote: The electron accelerates towards the positive plate due to a force F acting on it.

blocks.prompt:
37 Compare the path of a charged particle moving along a uniform field with one entering perpendicular to it.
(Uniform field ke saath chalne wale aur us par amoodi dakhil hone wale charged zarre ke raaston ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Field ke saath raasta seedha; amoodi dakhil hone par parabolic.

book_ref.quote: The path of a charged particle is determined by the electric field in the region.

header: Field par amoodi dakhil hota zarra
rows: Raasta seedha.
Raasta parabolic, ufuqi phainke gaye projectile ki tarah.
Force velocity ke saath; sirf speed badalti hai.
Ufuqi velocity mustaqil; amoodi velocity electric force se accelerate hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
38 Towards which plate is a charged particle deflected while passing between two oppositely charged plates?
(Mukhalif charged plates ke darmiyan se guzarta charged zarra kis plate ki taraf murta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Positive zarra negative plate ki taraf kheench kar usi taraf murta hai; negative zarra positive plate ki taraf murta hai.

book_ref.quote: a negatively charged particle is attracted towards the positively charged plate

blocks.prompt:
39 What is a Faraday cage? Give two examples from daily life.
(Faraday cage kya hai? Rozmarra zindagi se do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Faraday cage (Michael Faraday, 1836) aik conducting ghera hai jo bairooni electric fields ko rokta hai; khokhle conductor ke andar field sifr rehti hai. Misalein: toofan mein gaari ki dhaati body; microwave oven ki dhaati body (aur hawai jahaz ka dhaancha).

book_ref.quote: Faraday cage is an enclosure that blocks the external electric fields in conductive materials.

blocks.prompt:
40 Why does excess charge on a conductor reside on its surface?
(Conductor par zaid charge us ki satah par kyun rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har zaid electron hamsaya electrons ki field se dhakela jata hai, is liye sab satah ki taraf bhaagte hain. Static equilibrium ke baad harkat ruk jati hai aur zaid charge satah par rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: As a consequence, all the electrons rush to the surface of the conductor.

blocks.prompt:
41 Why is the electric field just outside a conductor perpendicular to its surface at equilibrium?
(Equilibrium mein conductor ki satah ke bilkul bahar electric field amoodi kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar E ka satah ke mutawazi component hota to satah ke aazad electrons chalne lagte. Equilibrium mein bahao nahi hota, is liye mutawazi component nahi aur E amoodi hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, there can be no parallel component, and the electric field is perpendicular to the surface.

blocks.prompt:
42 Why are sensitive circuits often enclosed in metal boxes?
(Hassas circuits aksar dhaati dabbon mein kyun band kiye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Conductor apne andar ki cheezon ko bairooni fields se bachata hai, kyunke satah ke charges aise tarteeb paate hain ke andar field sifr ho. Is liye dhaati dabbe bairooni fields ki mudakhlat khatam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: circuits are often enclosed within metal boxes that provide shielding from such fields

blocks.prompt:
43 What is drift velocity? Why do free electrons not accelerate continuously in a conductor?
(Drift velocity kya hai? Conductor mein aazad electrons musalsal accelerate kyun nahi hote?)
blocks.explanation: Aazad electrons conductor ke atoms se musalsal takrate aur lattice ko energy dete hain, is liye seedhi line mein accelerate nahi hote. Woh −E ke rukh mein aik average velocity hasil karte hain jo drift velocity hai (bohat kam).

book_ref.quote: The drift velocity is of the order of 10⁻³ m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
44 The drift velocity of electrons is very small. Why then does a bulb light up as soon as it is switched ON?
(Electrons ki drift velocity bohat kam hai. Phir switch ON karte hi bulb kyun jal uthta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Switch ON karte hi poore circuit ke aazad electrons aik saath drift shuru karte hain. Woh hamsayon ko dhakelte hain aur khalal taqreeban foran taar mein phailta hai, is liye current foran qaim hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The slow drift velocity does not mean that it takes long time for an electric current to set up.

blocks.prompt:
45 Differentiate between direct current and alternating current.
(Direct current aur alternating current mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: D.C aik rukh mein; A.C baqaida waqfon se rukh badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: If the charges move around a circuit in the same direction at all times

rows: Charges hamesha aik hi rukh mein chalte hain.
Charges aik taraf phir mukhalif taraf, baqaida waqfon se rukh badalte hain.
Batteries se milta hai.
Zyada tar generators se; power station gharon ko yahi dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
46 A current of 0.25 A flows in a wire for 2 minutes. Find the charge that passes and the number of electrons. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
(Aik taar mein 0.25 A current 2 minute tak behta hai. Guzarne wala charge aur electrons ki tadaad nikalein. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))

book_ref.quote: the current I flowing through it is:

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between conventional current and electronic current.
(Conventional current aur electronic current mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka circuit mein aik jaisa asar hai magar rukh mukhalif hai.

book_ref.quote: early scientists believed that electric current was due to flow of positive charges

rows: Positive charges ka farzi bahao.
Dhaati taaron mein manfi charges (aazad electrons) ka asal bahao.
Zyada se kam potential, yani positive se negative terminal ki taraf (cell ke bahar).
Electrons positive terminal par pohanchte hain, yani negative se positive ki taraf chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the expression for current in terms of drift velocity and explain the symbols.
(Drift velocity ki shakal mein current ka formula likhein aur alamaat ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: I = nAvq, jahan n per unit volume charge carriers ki tadaad, A cross-sectional area, v drift velocity aur q har carrier ka charge hai. (Q = nALq waqt t = L/v mein guzarta hai.)

book_ref.quote: Assuming that drift velocity of the charge carries to be v

blocks.prompt:
49 A copper wire of cross-section 4 × 10⁻⁶ m² carries 5 A. Find the drift velocity. (n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
(4 × 10⁻⁶ m² cross-section wali copper taar mein 5 A current hai. Drift velocity nikalein. (n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))

book_ref.quote: Consider a segment of the current carrying conductor having its length L

blocks.prompt:
50 State Ohm's law. Under what condition does it hold?
(Ohm ka qanoon bayan karein. Yeh kis shart par laagu hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Conductor mein current us par lage potential difference ke seedha mutanasib hai: V = RI. Yeh tab laagu hai jab conductor ki physical haalat (maslan temperature) na badle.

book_ref.quote: When a potential difference V is applied across the ends of a conductor

blocks.prompt:
51 Define one ohm. A 1.5 V cell drives 0.3 A through a resistor; find its resistance.
(Aik ohm ki definition likhein. 1.5 V cell resistor mein 0.3 A current chalata hai; us ki resistance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 1 Ω us conductor ki resistance hai jis mein 1 V lagane par 1 A behe. R = V/I = 1.5/0.3 = 5 Ω.

book_ref.quote: The resistance of a conductor is 1 ohm if a current of 1 ampere flows through it

blocks.text: 9.13 Resistivity and its dependence upon temperature

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between resistance and resistivity.
(Resistance aur resistivity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: R = ρL/A: resistance aik khaas taar ki, resistivity us ke maadde ki khususiyat hai.

book_ref.quote: where ρ (rho) is a constant of proportionality known as resistivity or specific resistance

rows: Aik khaas taar ki khususiyat.
Taar ke maadde ki khususiyat.
Lambai aur area par munhasir: R = ρL/A.
Maadde ke aik metre cube ki resistance: ρ = RA/L.
Unit: ohm (Ω).
Unit: ohm-metre (Ω m).

blocks.prompt:
53 Define conductance and conductivity. Give their units.
(Conductance aur conductivity ki definition aur units likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Conductance resistance ka ulat hai, G = 1/R (unit Ω⁻¹ ya mho). Conductivity resistivity ka ulat hai, σ = 1/ρ (unit Ω⁻¹ m⁻¹ ya mho m⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: In fact, conductance is the reciprocal of resistance, i.e.,

blocks.prompt:
54 A wire 2 m long with cross-section 1 × 10⁻⁷ m² has a resistance of 3.4 Ω. Find the resistivity of its material.
(2 m lambi aur 1 × 10⁻⁷ m² cross-section wali taar ki resistance 3.4 Ω hai. Us ke maadde ki resistivity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The length of the wire is 5.0 m and its cross-sectional area is 2.5 × 10⁻⁷ m².

blocks.prompt:
55 Define temperature coefficient of resistance and give its unit.
(Temperature coefficient of resistance ki definition aur unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh har kelvin par resistance ki kasri tabdeeli hai: α = (Rt − Ro)/(Ro t), jahan Ro aur Rt 0 °C aur t °C par resistances hain. Unit: K⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: where R_o and R_t are resistances at temperatures 0°C and t°C respectively

blocks.prompt:
56 A copper coil has a resistance of 10 Ω at 0 °C. Find its resistance at 100 °C. (α for copper = 0.0039 K⁻¹)
(Copper coil ki resistance 0 °C par 10 Ω hai. 100 °C par us ki resistance nikalein. (copper ka α = 0.0039 K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: Values of temperature coefficients of resistance of some substances are also listed in Table 9.2.

blocks.prompt:
57 What is meant by a negative temperature coefficient of resistance? Give two examples.
(Manfi temperature coefficient of resistance se kya muraad hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jis maadde ki resistance temperature barhne se kam ho us ka temperature coefficient manfi hai. Misalein: germanium aur silicon (aur carbon, Table 9.2).

book_ref.quote: There are some substances like germanium, silicon, etc. whose resistance decreases with increase in temperature

blocks.prompt:
58 Why are most electric wires made of copper?
(Zyada tar bijli ki taarein copper ki kyun banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 9.2 ke mutabiq silver aur copper ki resistivity sab se kam hai aur yeh behtareen conductors hain. Is liye zyada tar taarein copper ki banti hain.

book_ref.quote: That is the reason that most electric wires are made of copper.

blocks.prompt:
59 Show that the electrical power is P = VI and derive two other forms of it.
(Sabit karein ke electrical power P = VI hai aur is ki do aur shaklein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Di gayi energy W = VQ, is liye P = W/t = V(Q/t) = VI. V = IR rakhne se P = I²R; I = V/R rakhne se P = V²/R. V volts aur I amperes mein ho to P watts mein.

book_ref.quote: Using the definition of power, we have

blocks.prompt:
60 A bulb is rated 60 W, 220 V. Find its resistance and the current it draws at the rated voltage.
(Aik bulb 60 W, 220 V ka hai. Rated voltage par us ki resistance aur current nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The principle of conservation of energy tells us that the power dissipated in the resistor

blocks.prompt:
61 How much energy does a 60 W bulb use in one hour?
(60 W ka bulb aik ghante mein kitni energy istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Power per unit waqt energy hai, is liye energy = P × t = 60 × 3600 = 2.16 × 10⁵ J.

book_ref.quote: This is the energy supplied by the battery.

blocks.prompt:
62 Define emf. Why is it not a force?
(Emf ki definition likhein. Yeh force kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Emf E cell ki taraf se unit charge ko di gayi energy hai: E = W/Q. Yeh per unit charge energy hai, force nahi, is liye newtons mein nahi naapi jati; unit J C⁻¹ = volt.

book_ref.quote: The source must supply energy W to the positive charge to compel it to go to the point of high potential.

blocks.prompt:
63 Differentiate between emf and potential difference.
(Emf aur potential difference mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Emf sabab (cause) hai; potential difference us ka asar (effect).

book_ref.quote: The emf is always present even when no current is drawn through the battery or the cell

rows: Source ki taraf se unit charge ko di gayi energy.
Circuit ke kisi hisse mein per unit charge zaya energy (potential drop IR).
Sabab (cause).
Asar (effect).
Current na lene par bhi mojood.
Current na ho to conductor par sifr.

blocks.prompt:
64 What is the internal resistance of a cell? What causes it?
(Cell ki internal resistance kya hai? Is ki wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell bhi apne andar se guzarne wale current ki raah mein kuch resistance deta hai; yeh internal resistance r hai, jo electrodes ke darmiyan electrolyte ki wajah se hai. Cell khalis emf E aur series mein r ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: Like other components in a circuit, a cell also offers some resistance.

blocks.prompt:
65 Interpret the equation E = IR + Ir in terms of energy.
(E = IR + Ir ki energy ke lehaaz se tashreeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: E unit charge ki woh energy hai jo cell mein − se + tak hasil hoti hai. Is mein se Ir cell ke andar aur IR (potential drop) bahar ki resistance R mein zaya hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Let us interpret the Eq. 9.42 on energy considerations.

blocks.prompt:
66 A cell reads 1.5 V on open circuit and 1.2 V when connected across a 4 Ω resistor. Find the current and its internal resistance.
(Aik cell open circuit par 1.5 V aur 4 Ω resistor se jorne par 1.2 V parhta hai. Current aur internal resistance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The potential difference between the terminals of a battery in open circuit is 2.2 V.

blocks.prompt:
67 State Kirchhoff's first rule. Which conservation law does it express?
(Kirchhoff ka pehla usool bayan karein. Yeh kis tahaffuz ke qanoon ka izhaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi nuqte par milne wale tamam currents ka majmooa sifr hai, ΣI = 0; yani aane wale currents ka majmooa jane walon ke barabar. Yeh charge ke tahaffuz ka qanoon hai.

book_ref.quote: The sum of all the currents flowing towards a point is equal to the sum of all the currents flowing away from the point.

blocks.prompt:
68 State Kirchhoff's second rule. Which conservation law does it express?
(Kirchhoff ka doosra usool bayan karein. Yeh kis tahaffuz ke qanoon ka izhaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Band circuit ya loop mein potential (voltage) ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa sifr hai. Yeh energy ke tahaffuz ke qanoon ka aik khaas bayan hai.

book_ref.quote: The algebraic sum of potential changes in a closed circuit is zero.

blocks.prompt:
69 Write the sign conventions for potential changes across a cell and a resistor in Kirchhoff's second rule.
(Kirchhoff ke doosre usool mein cell aur resistor par potential ki tabdeeli ke nishanaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam se zyada potential ki taraf tabdeeli positive; zyada se kam ki taraf negative.

book_ref.quote: The book's own derivation, its For your information box and Example 9.10 use these signs.

rows: Cell ko − se + paar karna
+E
Cell ko + se − paar karna
−E
Resistor ko current ke rukh mein paar karna
−IR
Resistor ko current ke khilaf paar karna
+IR

blocks.prompt:
70 At a junction, currents of 4 A and 2.5 A enter and a current of 1.5 A leaves along with an unknown current I. Find I.
(Aik junction par 4 A aur 2.5 A ke currents andar aate hain aur 1.5 A ke saath aik na-maloom current I bahar jata hai. I nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle usool se andar ka majmooa = bahar ka majmooa: 4 + 2.5 = 1.5 + I, is liye I = 5 A (bahar).

book_ref.quote: According to the convention, currents I₁ and I₂ are positive and currents I₃ and I₄ are negative.

blocks.prompt:
71 What are a node and a datum node?
(Node aur datum node kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Node circuit ka woh nuqta hai jo do ya zyada shaakhon ko jorta hai. Jis node ka potential sifr liya jaye use datum node kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The node, which potential is taken as zero is called datum node.

blocks.prompt:
72 What are loop currents? What rule is followed for their direction?
(Loop currents kya hain? In ke rukh ke liye kaun sa usool hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har chune gaye loop mein farz kiye gaye currents loop currents hain; asal currents in se nikalte hain. Tamam loop currents aik hi rukh mein (sab clockwise ya sab anticlockwise) liye jaate hain; mushtarik resistor mein current in ka farq hai.

book_ref.quote: These currents are called loop currents.

blocks.prompt:
73 What is a Wheatstone bridge? Write its balance condition.
(Wheatstone bridge kya hai? Is ki balance ki shart likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh chaar resistances R₁, R₂, R₃, R₄ ka circuit hai jo mesh ABCDA banati hain; battery A aur C ke darmiyan aur galvanometer B aur D ke darmiyan. Balance (galvanometer mein current nahi) jab R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄.

book_ref.quote: We have to determine the condition under which no current flows through the galvanometer

blocks.prompt:
74 In a balanced Wheatstone bridge R₁ = 50 Ω, R₂ = 80 Ω and R₃ = 25 Ω. Find the unknown resistance R₄.
(Balanced Wheatstone bridge mein R₁ = 50 Ω, R₂ = 80 Ω aur R₃ = 25 Ω hain. Na-maloom resistance R₄ nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The balance condition is Eq. 9.51, R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄, which gives R₄ = R₂R₃/R₁

blocks.prompt:
75 Why should a voltmeter have a high resistance?
(Voltmeter ki resistance zyada kyun honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Agar is ki resistance circuit se kaafi zyada na ho to is mein qabil-e-zikr current behta hai jo circuit ka current aur naapa jane wala p.d. badal deta hai. Yeh sahi tab parhta hai jab current na le; ideal voltmeter ki resistance la-mehdood hai.

book_ref.quote: It is necessary that the resistance of the voltmeter be large compared to the circuit resistance

blocks.prompt:
76 State the principle of a potentiometer.
(Potentiometer ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yaksaan taar mein steady current ho to taar par potential drop us ki lambai ke mutanasib hai (V ∝ l). Null point par na-maloom emf balancing lambai par drop ke barabar hai, Eₓ = E l/L.

book_ref.quote: What it shares with the Wheatstone bridge is the null method, not the principle.

blocks.prompt:
77 A cell of emf 1.5 V balances at 60 cm on a potentiometer wire. Another cell balances at 48 cm. Find the emf of the second cell.
(1.5 V emf ka cell potentiometer taar par 60 cm par balance hota hai. Doosra cell 48 cm par. Doosre cell ki emf nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: E₁/E₂ = l₁/l₂, is liye E₂ = 1.5 × 48/60 = 1.2 V.

book_ref.quote: The method for measuring the emf of a cell as described above can be used to compare the emfs

blocks.prompt:
78 Why is a potentiometer better than an ordinary voltmeter for measuring the emf of a cell?
(Cell ki emf naapne ke liye potentiometer aam voltmeter se behtar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Voltmeter kuch current leta hai, is liye terminal voltage parhta hai, poori emf nahi. Potentiometer null point par emf naapta hai jab cell se koi current nahi liya jata, is liye bohat durust hai.

book_ref.quote: It can be seen that the unknown emf Eₓ is determined when no current is drawn from it

blocks.prompt:
79 What is the null method? Give two of its advantages.
(Null method kya hai? Is ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Circuit ko tab tak badla jata hai jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye; tab us ke dono sire aik potential par hote hain. Fawaid: (1) galvanometer ki internal resistance ka asar khatam; (2) galvanometer bohat hassas (taqreeban 10⁻⁶ A) aur 'no deflection' balance ka wazeh nishan.

book_ref.quote: There are some advantages of using a galvanometer in null method.

blocks.prompt:
80 What is a thermistor? How is it made?
(Thermistor kya hai? Yeh kaise banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermistor hararat se mutassir resistor hai; aksar ka temperature coefficient manfi. Yeh dhaati oxides (manganese, nickel, cobalt, copper, iron) ki semiconductor ceramic ko zyada pressure par garam kar ke, beads, rods ya washers ki shakal de kar zyada temperature par paka kar banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: These are pressed into desired shapes and then baked at high temperature.

blocks.prompt:
81 Give two applications of thermistors.
(Thermistors ke do istemalaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Temperature sensing: digital thermometers aur gaari ke engine ke coolant sensors mein overheating rokne ke liye. (2) Inrush current limiting: aala ON karte waqt ibtidai current mehdood karna. (Temperature compensation aur fire alarm bhi.)

book_ref.quote: Thermistors have wide applications as temperature sensors

blocks.prompt:
82 Differentiate between a thermistor and an LDR.
(Thermistor aur LDR mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Thermistor hararat par, LDR roshni par asar dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Thermistors with positive temperature coefficient are also available.

rows: Hararat se mutassir resistor.
Roshni se mutassir resistor (photo resistor).
Temperature barhne se resistance (aam tor par) kam.
Roshni barhne se resistance kam.
Dhaati oxides ki ceramic se bana.
Cadmium sulphide jaise semiconductor se bana.
Thermometers aur fire alarm mein.
Street lights aur camera exposure mein.

blocks.prompt:
83 What is the working principle of an LDR?
(LDR ka usool kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni padne par is ki conductivity barhti hai. Andhere mein semiconductor mein kam aazad electrons, is liye resistance zyada. Photons bahar ke electrons ko energy de kar aazad karte hain, resistance girti hai; kam roshni, kam aazad electrons, zyada resistance.

book_ref.quote: When light photons hit the material, they transfer energy to electrons in the outer orbits

blocks.prompt:
84 In an LDR voltage divider, why does the voltmeter reading across the LDR fall when light falls on it?
(LDR voltage divider mein LDR par roshni padne se us ke saath laga voltmeter kam reading kyun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Andhere mein LDR ki resistance 100 kΩ se bohat zyada hoti hai, is liye zyada voltage us par girta hai. Roshni mein resistance bohat kam ho jati hai, is liye us ka voltage ka hissa aur voltmeter ki reading kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: When the LDR is exposed to light, the resistance of LDR decreases to very low.

blocks.prompt:
85 How can carbon fibres be used to check the reliability of a concrete bridge?
(Carbon fibres se concrete pul ki mazbooti kaise jaanchi ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Conducting carbon fibres slab mein network ki shakal mein lagaye jaate hain aur chhota current guzara jata hai. Resistance waqt ke saath wahi rahe to pul mazboot hai; barhe to concrete kharab ho raha hai ya fibres toot rahe hain (darar ki wajah se).

book_ref.quote: They can determine the integrity of the concrete structure by measuring the resistance of the network.
